title: Publish Git content
description: Review the files and choose each repository that should receive them.
working_hint: Edits are saved on a dedicated working branch before publication.
no_sources: Add a Git source before choosing a repository.
source_error: Could not load Git sources. Reload and try again.
permission_hint: Your Git provider determines write access and branch protection. Browser publishing credentials are separate from backend catalog credentials.
credentials_hint: Connect each selected Git source for publishing from this browser. These credentials are stored in this browser for the selected backend, separately from catalog indexing credentials.
credential_connected: Publishing credential connected in this browser
credential_placeholder: Enter a token to connect or replace publishing access
credential_storage_error: This browser could not save the publishing credential. Check browser storage settings.
missing_credential: Connect publishing credentials for the working repository and each selected destination below, then publish again.
working_checkpoint: Save to the working branch first
dedicated_branch: Dedicated working branch for this draft
new_files_only: New files only: existing component directories are preserved.
publishing: Saving the working branch and publishing selected destinations…
select_destination: Select at least one destination to publish to.
invalid_repo: Enter a valid repository owner and name without the .git suffix.
invalid_branch: Enter a valid Git branch name.
invalid_path: Use relative repository paths without traversal or empty segments.
duplicate_destination: Each repository, branch and directory can be selected only once.
source_changed: The Git source configuration changed. Review the destinations again before publishing.
no_files: There are no files to publish.
review_error: Could not prepare the publication preview.
publish_error: Publication failed. Check the source connection and repository permissions, then retry.
fork_auto: Use my personal fork if upstream is read-only
checkpoint_fork_hint: If this working repository is read-only, Save creates or reuses a verified fork in the connected personal account. Its working branch and commit become the deployment source.
connection_hint: Choose where this project is saved. Connect records the repository settings; Save then writes a dedicated working branch, using your personal fork when selected.
review_unsupported: Open this review on the Git provider to continue.
merge_unconfirmed: The Git provider did not confirm the merge. Refresh its status before retrying.
review_changed: This branch changed since publication. Review and publish the new snapshot before merging.
merge_ready: Your published commit is ready to merge. Repository checks and approvals still apply.
merge_blocked: Merge is unavailable. Check your permissions, approvals, checks, and conflicts on the Git provider.
fork_owner_hint: Leave empty for your personal account. The selected namespace must allow you to create and write forks.
